type.text: 把素材.mp4处理一下：转个小尺寸、抽音轨、再抽一帧

eval: (()=>{const vs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.view.on .pvmed video')];const as=[...document.querySelectorAll('.view.on .pvmed audio')];const v=vs[0];const a=as[0];const card=v?v.closest('.card'):null;const vr=v?v.getBoundingClientRect():null;const ar=a?a.getBoundingClientRect():null;const cr=card?card.getBoundingClientRect():null;return {videos:vs.length,audios:as.length,decodeW:v?v.videoWidth:0,decodeH:v?v.videoHeight:0,vidDur:+(v?v.duration:0).toFixed(2),readyState:v?v.readyState:-1,audioDur:+(a?a.duration:0).toFixed(2),geoVW:vr?Math.round(vr.width):0,geoVH:vr?Math.round(vr.height):0,geoAW:ar?Math.round(ar.width):0,geoAH:ar?Math.round(ar.height):0,insideCard:!!(vr&&cr&&vr.left>=cr.left-2&&vr.right<=cr.right+2),noPageOverflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=document.documentElement.clientWidth,frameThumb:(()=>{const i=document.querySelector('.view.on .thumbs img');return i?{nw:i.naturalWidth,nh:i.naturalHeight}:'none'})()}})()

(async()=>{const one=(el)=>new Promise(r=>{if(!el)return r('no element');if(el.readyState>=1)return r({w:el.videoWidth||0,d:+(el.duration||0).toFixed(2),rs:el.readyState,ns:el.networkState});const t=setTimeout(()=>r({timeout:true,rs:el.readyState,ns:el.networkState}),9000);el.onloadedmetadata=()=>{clearTimeout(t);r({w:el.videoWidth||0,d:+(el.duration||0).toFixed(2),rs:el.readyState,ns:el.networkState})};el.load()});const v=document.querySelector('.view.on .pvmed video');const a=document.querySelector('.view.on .pvmed audio');return {video:await one(v),audio:await one(a)}})()

(async()=>{const p=(s)=>encodeURIComponent(s);const out={};const r1=await fetch('/api/media?sid='+encodeURIComponent(curId)+'&path='+p('小.mp4'),{headers:{Range:'bytes=100-199'}});out.rangeStatus=r1.status;out.contentRange=r1.headers.get('content-range');out.acceptRanges=r1.headers.get('accept-ranges');out.gotBytes=(await r1.arrayBuffer()).byteLength;const r2=await fetch('/api/media?sid='+encodeURIComponent(curId)+'&path='+p('音轨.mp3'));out.mp3Status=r2.status;out.mp3Type=r2.headers.get('content-type');const r3=await fetch('/api/media?sid='+encodeURIComponent(curId)+'&path='+p('../../../Windows/win.ini'));out.escapeStatus=r3.status;const r4=await fetch('/api/media?sid='+encodeURIComponent(curId)+'&path='+p('根本没有这个.mp4'));out.missingStatus=r4.status;return out})()

(async()=>{const v=document.querySelector('.view.on .pvmed video');const t0=v.currentTime;return await new Promise(res=>{const to=setTimeout(()=>res({seeked:false,before:+t0.toFixed(2),after:+v.currentTime.toFixed(2)}),6000);v.onseeked=()=>{clearTimeout(to);res({seeked:true,before:+t0.toFixed(2),after:+v.currentTime.toFixed(2)})};v.currentTime=2.0})})()

(async()=>{const one=(el)=>new Promise(r=>{if(!el)return r('no element');if(el.readyState>=1)return r({w:el.videoWidth||0,d:+(el.duration||0).toFixed(2),rs:el.readyState,ns:el.networkState});const t=setTimeout(()=>r({timeout:true,rs:el.readyState,ns:el.networkState}),9000);el.onloadedmetadata=()=>{clearTimeout(t);r({w:el.videoWidth||0,d:+(el.duration||0).toFixed(2),rs:el.readyState,ns:el.networkState})};el.load()});const v=document.querySelector('.view.on .pvmed video');const a=document.querySelector('.view.on .pvmed audio');return {afterReloadVideo:await one(v),afterReloadAudio:await one(a)}})()

(async()=>{const wait=(el,ms)=>new Promise(r=>{const t=setTimeout(()=>r('TIMEOUT rs='+el.readyState+' ns='+el.networkState+' err='+(el.error?el.error.code:'-')),ms);el.onloadedmetadata=()=>{clearTimeout(t);r('OK w='+el.videoWidth+' d='+el.duration)}});const v=document.querySelector('.view.on .pvmed video');const inCard=v.closest('.card');const open=inCard?inCard.open:'no-card';inCard&&(inCard.open=true);v.preload='auto';v.load();const a=await wait(v,7000);const fresh=document.createElement('video');fresh.src=v.getAttribute('src');fresh.preload='auto';document.body.appendChild(fresh);const b=await wait(fresh,7000);fresh.remove();return 'vis='+document.visibilityState+' detailsOpen='+open+' 卡里的='+a+' 新塞body的='+b})()
